decisions.changed_angle: There is no new financing or asset-purchase source since the July2 appearance. The planned Pentagon stake and magnet-plant support are the same July10 stories already available to the July11 edition. The shortened 157-word side explicitly calls this a policy-financing carryover, supplies no new operating result and retains updated own-card context with execution, dilution and valuation risks. The repeated crypto-family presence does not imply the same audience or investment claim. The crypto-family frequency diagnostic spans distinct assets and developments. Those access and balance-sheet developments support a separate selection after the earlier Bitcoin-policy/breakout and treasury-equity narratives. Keep the distinction between token exposure and the funding premium of a treasury share.

Retain the XRP side for its own concrete July17 peak/regulatory-advance headline and July16 Ripple-Ctrl Alt tokenization agreement. This differs from Bitcoin ETF/legislation attention and Ether institutional-access/treasury mechanics elsewhere in the trailing sequence. The prose keeps token-holder returns separate from infrastructure adoption and supplies a reversal/liquidity risk, with no reserved crypto slot or measured popularity claim.

The Marina expansion and Stocktwits retail-attention story were already used July16. Retain the147word side as an explicitly named capacity-expansion carryover with updated completed-close context and execution/funding risk, without suggesting a new commercial milestone.

After July18 initial retail-resurrection coverage and July21 weekly frenzy/sponsorship, the July22 lead addresses fresh July21 reporting of Eric Jackson saying the shares are worth40dollars and explicit Reddit meme framing.
